title: Action Generator
description: Generate Next.js server actions with automatic error handling, validation, and API integration. Automatically creates lib/client/config.ts on first use.

name.description: Name of the action (e.g., getUser, createPost, deleteComment). Uses standard naming conventions.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this action?

actionType.description: Type of server action: 'api' for external API calls, 'db' for database operations, 'form' for form submission handling

x-prompt.message: What type of action would you like to generate?

items.label: API - Call external API endpoints with error handling
DB - Perform database operations with Prisma
Form - Handle form submissions and validation

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where actions are created (default: 'lib' creates src/lib/actions/)

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for action creation

projectName.description: Target project name where action will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

useTypes.description: Generate TypeScript type definitions in src/lib/types/ (default: true for API actions)

useConstant.description: Generate constants in src/lib/constants/ (endpoints, default values, etc.)

useMapper.description: Generate data mapper utility function for response transformation

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

clientPackage.description: API client package to import from. Use @next-feature/client (default) or custom package like @myorg/api-client

export.description: Export the generated action from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
